title: 准备—冻结分离

ddl.ddl: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS r27_live_frozen(policy_hash TEXT NOT NULL,target_ordinal INTEGER NOT NULL,target_issue TEXT NOT NULL,position INTEGER NOT NULL,probabilities BLOB NOT NULL,n1 INTEGER NOT NULL,n2 INTEGER NOT NULL,n3 INTEGER NOT NULL,act INTEGER NOT NULL,status TEXT NOT NULL,frozen_at INTEGER NOT NULL,deadline_at INTEGER NOT NULL,hit INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT -1,settled_at INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,PRIMARY KEY(policy_hash,target_ordinal))

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS r27_opportunity(target_ordinal INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,target_issue TEXT NOT NULL,scheduled INTEGER NOT NULL,frozen INTEGER NOT NULL,acted INTEGER NOT NULL,settled INTEGER NOT NULL,deadline_missed INTEGER NOT NULL,recorded_at INTEGER NOT NULL)
